descriptionFull: The Alder Flycatcher ( Empidonax alnorum ) is a small insect-eating bird of the tyrant flycatcher family. The genus name Empidonax is from Ancient Greek empis , "gnat", and anax , "master". The specific alnorum is Latin and means "of the alders".
